title: Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 compact baseline on one DGX Spark (GB10)
purpose: Establish the reproducible text-only performance, quality, stability, and memory baseline for Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 on a single DGX Spark (128 GB unified memory), and evaluate candidate factory engines on the same checkpoint and workload.

covers: Three measured 512-input / 32-output performance requests (engine decode throughput, E2E output throughput, and client TTFT)
Compact text-only quality and determinism gates: GSM8K (3 questions), RULER (~2K context, 2 tasks), infer-check determinism (1 prompt x 2 runs), and 2x16 top-5 token probabilities
Memory accounting by category (GPU working set, host anonymous memory, minimum system MemAvailable), SSD read split, cold load time, and L2 disconnect recovery
Separate Nsight Systems profiling pass (two 80/16 requests, marked non-comparable for speed)
excludes: Full-dataset GSM8K/RULER or 4K/16K context sweeps (reduced to fit a single 12-hour DGX Spark window on unoptimized llama.cpp)
Multimodal inputs, concurrent load (concurrency > 1), and multi-GPU communication
T3 engine-internal counters not present in native llama.cpp (L3.step_phase_split, L4.expert_selection, M.expert_tier_share, L5.fastpath_fallback_rate)
Nsight Compute hardware counter ratios requiring admin privileges on shared DGX Spark

arms.summary: Factory-optimized inference engine evaluated on the identical NVFP4 checkpoint and compact workload.

engine_decode_tok_s.how: Sum of generated tokens (excluding first token) divided by sum of engine predicted_ms across the 3 measured pp512_tg32 requests.

e2e_output_tok_s.how: Total output tokens divided by wall-clock window from first measured request send to last measured request completion (includes prefill and gaps).

client_ttft_ms.how: Client-observed time from request send to first non-empty streamed event across the 3 measured pp512_tg32 requests.

gsm8k_exact_match.how: Strict exact-match score on the 3-question GSM8K compact sample.

ruler_match.how: Mean selected_sample_match across niah_single_2 and ruler_qa_hotpot (~2K context).

determinism_score.how: Mean determinism score from infer-check (seed 1234, temperature 0, 2 repeats).

gpu_working_set_gib.how: Peak GPU working set (weights, KV cache, compute buffers) reported from startup buffer allocation and CUDA memory delta.

host_anonymous_gib.how: Peak engine anonymous host memory from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup (excludes reclaimable checkpoint file pages).

mem_available_min_gib.how: Minimum system MemAvailable observed in /proc/meminfo during the run.

storage_read_prefill_gb.how: Aggregate physical SSD read upper bound during prefill across the 3 measured pp512_tg32 requests.

storage_read_decode_gb.how: Aggregate physical SSD read upper bound during decode across the 3 measured pp512_tg32 requests.

cold_load_seconds.how: Cold-start seconds from engine launch until health endpoint reports ready.

protocol.notes: Warm-up and auxiliary calibration requests are archived but excluded from the 3 measured pp512_tg32 metrics. Profiling runs under Nsight Systems are always separate and marked non-comparable.

checks.does: GSM8K strict exact match meets or exceeds the frozen floor (draft floor: 1.0 on the 3-question compact sample, pending sponsor freeze).
RULER selected_sample_match meets or exceeds the frozen floor (draft floor: 1.0 on the 2-task ~2K compact sample, pending sponsor freeze).
infer-check determinism score equals 1.0 across identical seeded repeats with natural stop.
Selected quality and determinism requests finish naturally with 0% finish_reason==length truncation.
GPU working set stays within agreed working-set budget and system MemAvailable stays above 8 GiB safety floor.
After mid-stream client disconnect, slot returns to idle, anonymous memory delta stays <= 256 MiB, and a follow-up request succeeds.

rules: DRAFT THRESHOLDS (baseline-anchored, pending A/A noise measurement and sponsor freeze before optimization).

Baseline reference (2026-11-26 verified Spark run): engine_decode_tok_s = 0.2289 tokens/s, e2e_output_tok_s = 0.0642 tokens/s, gsm8k = 1.0 (3/3), ruler = 1.0 (2/2), determinism = 1.0, gpu_working_set = 45.66 GiB, mem_available_min = 70.64 GiB.
Candidate runs must pass gsm8k_gate, ruler_gate, determinism_gate, zero_truncation_gate, and memory_budget_gate on the exact same NVFP4 checkpoint.
Speed numbers count only from comparable runs with no profiler attached and no competing GPU processes.
Blocked or incomplete runs are reported as partial/failed and never recorded as zero.

execution.notes: Executed via LabAgent CommandAdapter calling python -m benchmarks.ifbench.lab_adapter {package} {output} {payloads}.

notes: Grounded in the 2026-11-26 DGX Spark verified baseline archive (SHA-256 ae2a4fa45c779861d9d2b8482f4fb2a09ab2b0c09fd0c3e93d7386dd4ae2ac83, 426 files verified, rev4 60-item coverage).
